title: Fogbound Hex Cartographers
constraints: uses only one interaction type (click OR drag OR type)

workerResult.summary: Fogbound Hex Cartographers: click-only cottagecore hex game. Seeded 8x7 fog-grid SVG map with 6 terrains; click fog to chart, click to claim, click-pick names from generated cards; click two claims to stitch trade routes (+3 baskets); midnight countdown auto-reshuffle plus night-bell button; 4 NPC wanderers co-claim with logbook; localStorage persistence; responsive to 375px.
